edits.old: Then the run summary names "PAY-91002" with MSG-P8-001
edits.new:
Then the run summary names "PAY-91002" with MSG-P8-001

  Scenario: AC13 Payment above the installment by more than the tolerance (exception X5)
    Given payment "PAY-91007" of 13,000.00 THB is received against the installment of 12,500.00 THB
    When "PAY-91007" is matched
    Then "PAY-91007" is unmatched and held on the exception list
    Then the run summary names "PAY-91007" with MSG-P8-001

  Scenario: AC14 Two rows match one payment (exception X6)
    Given payment "PAY-91008" is matched by two rows of PAYMENT_MATCH version "PM-2026.12"
    When "PAY-91008" is matched
    Then the row with the lower row order decides
    Then the system writes one decision record for "PAY-91008"

  Scenario: AC17 Matching reads the evaluated model only and the registers carry no personal data (BR10 to BR14)
    Given the fetched PAYMENT_MATCH model of "PM-2026.12" has a checksum mismatch
    When JOB-07 runs for business date 2026-12-15
    Then the last good model of the version in force is kept and no match is taken on the unverified model
    Then the match record of "PAY-91001" holds no personal data field

  Scenario: AC18 Caller without a valid credential gets 401
    When the caller sends GET /api/recovery/payment/v1/proceeds without a valid credential
    Then the response is status 401

  Scenario: AC18 Caller without the role of the operation gets 403
    When the caller sends GET /api/recovery/payment/v1/proceeds without the role of the operation
    Then the response is status 403

  Scenario: AC18 Payment with no proceeds row gets 404
    When the caller sends GET /api/recovery/payment/v1/proceeds for a payment that has no proceeds row
    Then the response is status 404

  Scenario: AC19 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given the match of "PAY-91001" has been written once with an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the system writes no second proceeds row for "PAY-91001"

  Scenario: AC20 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given a consumed event has been processed once
    When the same event ID is delivered again
    Then the inbox dedupes the event and no second side effect is written

  Scenario: AC21 Activity retry and timeout follow the kit policy
    Given the rwb-treatment contract does not answer within 2 s for "PAY-91002" on the first attempt
    When the activity retries on the kit policy
    Then "PAY-91002" is matched at most once
